_about: USD per million tokens, for Outpost War's cost per side (tools/war_models.mjs callCost). in: uncached input; cacheRead: input read from the prompt cache; cacheWrite: input written to it (Anthropic, 5-minute cache: 1.25x input); out: output, thinking included. Anthropic: first-party API rates (2026-10). OpenAI: approximate, from third-party price lists on 2026-10-23 (they disagree; check openai.com/api/pricing); cached input taken as a tenth of input.
